title: Monsoon Alert Issued for 13 States, Heavy Rain Expected
summary: A low-pressure system is expected to bring heavy rain and thunderstorms to 13 states on August 2. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued a warning for the region. According to the IMD, the low-pressure system will affect eastern and western parts of Uttar Pradesh, leading to heavy rainfall in some areas.
summary_points: A low-pressure system is expected to bring heavy rain and thunderstorms to 13 states on August 2.
The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued a warning for the region.
The low-pressure system will affect eastern and western parts of Uttar Pradesh, leading to heavy rainfall in some areas.
Heavy rain is expected in these regions, with thunderstorms also possible.
